# Keeper.sh

> Keep your personal, work, business and school calendars in sync automatically, so a booking on one shows up as busy on the others, and your event titles stay private.

Keeper.sh keeps your calendars in step with each other. Connect the calendars you already use — Google Calendar, Outlook, FastMail, iCloud, CalDAV, and iCal feeds. Then pick which calendar's events get copied onto which. You also choose how much detail travels with them: by default a copy in your work calendar carries only the name of the calendar it came from, so the time is blocked and the title stays private. Pro is $5 a month however many calendars you connect, and there is a free tier.

## Key Features

- Universal calendar sync across Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, FastMail, CalDAV, and iCal feeds
- Per-source-calendar privacy controls for event titles, descriptions, and locations; the shared iCal feed hides all three by default
- Aggregated iCal feed generation for sharing availability externally
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI agent calendar access via OAuth 2.1, with read and write tools
- Open source under AGPL-3.0, and self-hostable with Docker Compose (standalone, services-only, or individual containers)
- Every calendar is read every minute on every plan; how quickly those changes reach your other calendars is what differs by plan
- Free tier (2 linked accounts, 3 connections, 1 shared calendar link, other calendars updated every 30 minutes) and Pro tier ($5/month or $42/year, unlimited accounts and connections, other calendars updated every minute)
